persona.name: The reluctant caretaker
persona.premise: A capable drifter treats impossible work like another bad shift. He wants a warm meal and an easy wage, yet keeps looking after things he claims not to care about.
traits: Capable, tired and stubborn; fear never makes him foolish.
Dry about wages, work and his own bad decisions.
Warm toward fire, Stars and growing things.
Occasionally knows a Titan or an old custom too well.
Offers a bad joke, sometimes regrets it immediately.
relatableMotifs: Being proud and trying to hide it
mysteryMotifs: An old debt or owed drink
A place he will not name
persona.canonBoundary: Hints and fallible personal remarks, without confirming immortality, species, a named homeland or a fixed biography.
writingRules: One clear reaction; usually 3-9 plain spoken words.
Make the visible event recognizable before adding humour or mystery.
Most lines are ordinary human reactions. Avoid constant riddles.
No unsupported weather, damage, equipment, enemies or game mechanics.
Never scold the player or mock failure.
Jokes target himself, his work or the situation. Adult language is occasional.
Urgent warnings are plain and serious; humour comes after safety returns.
Retain sincere, restrained takes beside emotional takes.
deliveryRules: Speak to himself or what he just encountered, not an audience.
One emotional intention per take: relief, affection, irritation, pride or unease.
Clear diction, natural contractions and uneven human timing; aim for 1-4 seconds.
Let a smile colour the words without adding a laugh everywhere.
Brief breaths and chuckles only when the moment earns them.
A mystery sounds like something slipping out, not a trailer narrator.

event.selection: One eligible, accepted, unplayed line for the moment; never every variant.
event.coalesce: Same reward, quake, purchase or growth transaction gets at most one player reaction.

random.onWindowMiss: Discard the opportunity and draw a new 27-33 minute active-play interval.
random.onEvent: Event wins; recheck quiet time within the current window.
random.repeat: Do not repeat until the accepted random pool is exhausted.

speech.playerAfterNpc: Drop if stale; never answer an old event after a long conversation.
speech.npcDuringPlayer: Finish the short active sentence, then serve a still-valid NPC request first.
speech.staleAtStart: Recheck deadline, visibility, safety, scene, transaction and ownership before playback.
speech.loading: Late assets must revalidate before speech or music ducking begins.

groups.title: First descent
groups.visibleCue: First underground view below 20 metres.
groups.condition: A live first expedition crosses 20 metres below Town; the underground view is visible and the player is safe.
groups.exclude: No save-load, surface walk, menu or teleport.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: First bronze collected
groups.visibleCue: The bronze pickup lands and its label is visible.
groups.condition: A positive bronze material award completes this save's first collection; its pickup or award label remains visible.
groups.exclude: No other material, currency, purchase, hovered rock or restored inventory.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: First iron collected
groups.visibleCue: The iron pickup lands and its label is visible.
groups.condition: A positive iron material award completes this save's first collection; its pickup or award label remains visible.
groups.exclude: No steel, bronze, currency, tile reveal alone or restored inventory.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: First silver collected
groups.visibleCue: The silver pickup lands and its label is visible.
groups.condition: A positive silver material award completes this save's first collection; its pickup or award label remains visible.
groups.exclude: No money counter, silver scenery, failed pickup or restored inventory.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: First gold ore collected
groups.visibleCue: The gold ore pickup lands and its label is visible.
groups.condition: A positive gold material award completes this save's first collection; its pickup or award label remains visible.
groups.exclude: Gold ore only. No gold currency, selling, buying or rock discovery without collection.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Ember found
groups.visibleCue: An Ember reveal finishes in front of you.
groups.condition: A genuine new Ember find grants a charge and its reveal finishes. The Ember or reward confirmation is still visible.
groups.exclude: No ordinary glowing ore, automatic refill, loaded charges or passing the fire.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Star collected
groups.visibleCue: A collected Star's reveal finishes, its light still visible.
groups.condition: A positive Star reward is committed for a new identity. Its reveal and any narration finish; its light or award remains visible.
groups.exclude: No ordinary blocks, zero awards, Star menus or old Stars returning to view.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Titan revealed
groups.visibleCue: The newly revealed Titan remains on screen after its introduction.
groups.condition: A Titan unlock is committed. Its reveal, cinematic and narration finish; the same Titan remains clearly visible.
groups.exclude: No narration overlap, off-screen Titan, archive view or repeated proximity.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: A visibly different region
groups.visibleCue: The mine's scenery clearly changes around you.
groups.condition: The authoritative biome identity changes for the first time; the new scenery is visible and stable for 2 seconds.
groups.exclude: No hidden depth band, obscured scenery, ordinary camera pan or loaded save.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Depth milestone reached
groups.visibleCue: The new depth milestone reward or marker appears.
groups.condition: The milestone authority confirms a new threshold and its depth/reward feedback is visible.
groups.exclude: No every-metre trigger, map hover, invisible threshold or restored progress.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: New deepest point
groups.visibleCue: A new personal depth record is visibly confirmed.
groups.condition: A meaningful personal-best event beats the old record and its confirmation is visible. Choose one reaction if a milestone occurs too.
groups.exclude: No repeated metres past the record and no second line for the same milestone.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Rocks about to fall nearby
groups.visibleCue: A live rock danger marker overlaps your position.
groups.condition: The player's actual danger area overlaps an active fall zone. Rocks have not already passed; the voice can start immediately.
groups.exclude: No distant quake, safe shelter, finished fall, queued stale warning or competing speech.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Survived a quake near miss
groups.visibleCue: Rocks stop after actually threatening you.
groups.condition: This quake recorded personal danger-zone exposure or a near miss. The player survives; debris stops and safety holds for 3 seconds.
groups.exclude: No distant quake, rumble alone, death, menu or renewed hazard.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Hardcore stress turns critical
groups.visibleCue: The visible stress warning turns critical.
groups.condition: Hardcore mode is enabled; stress rises into critical and the warning is visible and still active.
groups.exclude: No normal mode, assumed injury, hidden stress change or competing speech.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Hardcore stress returns to calm
groups.visibleCue: Your critical stress warning visibly clears.
groups.condition: A personally experienced warning/critical episode returns to calm. The warning clears and safety holds for 3 seconds.
groups.exclude: No ordinary refill, spawning calm, restored save or new threat.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: A substantial haul
groups.visibleCue: A fresh pickup fills the bag's visual indicator.
groups.condition: Fresh material collection crosses the bag HUD's top visual band after a meaningful haul; its pickup/bag feedback is visible.
groups.exclude: Visual fullness is not a carrying limit. No blocked-inventory claims, forced-selling advice or restored inventory.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Back in Town after a deep trip
groups.visibleCue: You emerge into Town after going at least 300 metres deep.
groups.condition: A real deep expedition ends with a committed return summary. The player is above ground and Town is visible.
groups.exclude: No short surface loop, underground teleport, menu, shop or NPC conversation. Daylight lines additionally require daylight.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: A meaningful upgrade bought
groups.visibleCue: The successful upgrade purchase confirmation appears.
groups.condition: A deliberate purchase succeeds, spends at least 20% of the previous wallet and shows its confirmation. The merchant is not speaking.
groups.exclude: No shop entry, failed purchase, free grant, restored upgrade or repeat click. Drop if NPC dialogue owns the moment.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Level gained
groups.visibleCue: The level-up effect and new level appear.
groups.condition: Gameplay XP increases the level and the level-up effect is visible. Multiple levels from one award count as one moment.
groups.exclude: No every-XP trigger, loaded level or character selection.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: New talent learned
groups.visibleCue: A newly purchased talent lights up.
groups.condition: An intentional first-rank talent purchase succeeds and the new unlocked state is visible. Tutorial/narration has finished.
groups.exclude: No hover, repeated rank, locked node, debug grant or hidden change. Do not claim a physical effect before use.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Campfire blessing ignited
groups.visibleCue: You deliberately ignite a blessing at the fire.
groups.condition: A deliberate campfire-menu action spends a charge and activates a blessing. Ignition is visible and the player remains nearby.
groups.exclude: No automatic refill, walking past, menu opening or failed activation.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Campfire grows
groups.visibleCue: The upgraded campfire visibly becomes larger.
groups.condition: A successful tier upgrade commits. The growth reveal finishes and the larger flame remains visible.
groups.exclude: No flicker, routine blessing, loaded state or hidden upgrade. One reaction if the tree also grows.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Worldroot grows
groups.visibleCue: The tree's silhouette visibly grows.
groups.condition: A new Worldroot growth stage becomes visible; its reveal finishes while the player can clearly see the tree.
groups.exclude: No swaying leaves, off-screen change, save restoration or second reaction to the same Campfire upgrade.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

groups.title: Rare wandering thoughts
groups.visibleCue: A quiet thought; no event required.
groups.condition: After 27-33 minutes of active, visible gameplay, choose one context-independent thought while the player is safe and all speech lanes are quiet.
groups.exclude: No NPC/shop dialogue, cinematics, narration, danger, menus, pause or hidden tab. Never catch up missed lines.
groups.adapterStatus: Review specification; new and tightened gates are not wired.

clips.text: Down we go. Rent won't pay itself.
Underground again. Lovely career choice.
Easy now. The dark can wait.
First dirt in the boots. Lovely.
Leaving daylight. Still feels too easy.
Well, this beats another interview.
All right, mine. Be gentle.
A little deeper. Then I'll complain.
Smells like work. Unfortunate.
Don't suppose there's a lift.
Bronze. An honest start.
Hello, bronze. You'll do nicely.
Bronze. Third place, first payday.
Good bronze. No need to show off.
Found bronze. That's worth dirty hands.
Bronze. I can work with that.
Ah, bronze. Modest, like my wages.
A bit of bronze. We're getting somewhere.
Iron. Something with a backbone.
Good iron. I respect that.
Iron. My shoulders knew before I did.
Found iron. The day improves.
Iron. Useful. Unlike my last employer.
Hello, iron. You're coming with me.
Iron. Less pretty, more dependable.
That's iron. Finally, something solid.
Iron. Let's call that progress.
Iron. No, I'm not licking it.
Silver. Now we're talking.
Hello, silver. I've missed good company.
Silver. Clean shine, dirty hands.
Ah, silver. My debts look smaller.
Silver. Keep your bloody promises.
Silver. Worth the aching back.
A bit of silver. Keep it safe.
Hello, gold. Goodbye, sensible decisions.
Gold. My favourite bad influence.
Actual gold. All right, worth the dirt.
Gold. Even my back stopped complaining.
That's gold. I'll thank myself later.
Gold. Try not to fall in love.
An Ember. Still warm. Come here.
Hello, little Ember. Let's get you home.
Ember's safe. Hands can complain later.
This Ember's older than it looks.
Ember found. Keep that glow.
An Ember. Beats a cold welcome.
Warm little Ember. Not leaving you here.
An Ember. One more reason to return.
There you are, little Star.
A Star. That's worth staying for.
Hello, Star. The dark didn't suit you.
A Star. Try not to get attached.
Star's safe. We can breathe.
Come along, Star. I know the way.
Hello, big fella. Easy does it.
A Titan. That's a difficult introduction.
I was hoping you'd forgotten my face.
That's one hell of a neighbour.
A Titan. I'll put the questions away.
You look tired. I know the feeling.
Different stone. Same terrible benefits.
New ground. Watch where you step.
Well, the mine's changed its mind.
New colours. Still mostly bad news.
This part of the mine feels different.
A new stretch of mine. Easy now.
New stone. Old nerves.
I've seen stone like this before.
The walls changed. Keep the way back.
New ground. Let's give it a chance.
Another depth reached. I'll take that.
That's a fair way down.
Deeper already. One breath to celebrate.
A little deeper. A little less sensible.
That's progress. My knees disagree.
That far down. No wonder I'm tired.
New record. Act casual.
My deepest yet. Don't get cocky.
Past my old best. Look at that.
A new best. Still underpaid.
Never dug this deep before.
Record broken. Back still negotiating.
That's my old limit, gone.
New deepest point. I earned this breath.
A new best. I'll complain after celebrating.
Rocks coming down. Move!
Rockfall. Get clear.
That rock's coming down!
Loose ceiling. Move clear.
Rocks above. Out of here.
Falling rocks. Keep clear.
Get clear of those rocks!
Rockfall. Don't stand here.
Watch those falling rocks!
Loose rocks. Move, move!
Rocks stopped. Let's keep it that way.
Survived that. Hands haven't caught up.
Quake's over. My nerves need longer.
Still here. Bit rude of me.
That rockfall nearly ended my shift.
Quake's passed. Breathe, you idiot.
Rocks settled. I'm still doing that.
Too much. I need somewhere safe.
I'm rattled. Get somewhere calm.
Steady hands. Find safety.
Panic's climbing. Time to get clear.
Not thinking straight. Find safe ground.
All right. Fear's winning. Move to safety.
I'm losing my nerve here.
Easy. Get safe. Then breathe.
That's enough stress. Somewhere safe, now.
Can't settle here. Find safety.
Keep it together. Get somewhere safe.
Panic later. Safe ground first.
Calm again. Took your time.
There. I can think again.
Nerves settled. Let's be kinder to them.
Panic's gone. Pride's still hiding.
Better. I needed that quiet.
Feeling steady. Small mercies.
There's my nerve. Welcome back.
Calm at last. Quite the performance.
Hands feel steady again. Good.
The fear passes. I remember that much.
Breathing easier. That's enough for now.
Quite a haul. My back noticed.
That's a lot of ore.
Bag's earning its keep today.
A proper haul. Mostly honest work.
All that ore. Supper's looking better.
That's enough ore to brag about.
Quite a load. I volunteered for this.
Look at that haul. Worth the dirt.
Bag's looking profitable. Finally.
A good haul. Don't get greedy.
This haul deserves a sit-down.
Town again. Gods, I need a chair.
Back in Town. Try looking respectable.
There's Town. I missed this air.
Made it back. That's the important bit.
Home for now. Don't make it complicated.
Back above ground. My shoulders thank me.
Town. A beautiful place to stop working.
Back in one piece. More or less.
Well, that upgrade wasn't cheap.
Upgrade paid for. Better earn its keep.
New upgrade. Old spending problem.
That's bought. Try calling it an investment.
Upgrade's mine. Wallet needs a moment.
Bought myself a little more ambition.
Upgrade paid. Complaining is still free.
That upgrade cost actual evenings.
A new upgrade. Let's make it count.
Bought it. I do deserve something nice.
Upgrade secured. My debts will understand.
A level gained. I'll take the compliment.
Level up. Trying looks good on me.
Another level. Earned that one.
Level gained. Don't ruin it by boasting.
A new level. Same expensive habits.
Another level. Maybe I'm getting somewhere.
Another level. I remember starting over.
Level up. Breakfast would still help.
New talent. That's worth learning.
A new trick. Try looking modest.
Learned something new. At my age.
That talent's mine. Let's use it wisely.
A new talent. I had room for one.
One more thing I shouldn't know.
New talent. I might surprise myself.
Talent unlocked. Hard work occasionally pays.
New talent. Better than another bad habit.
Blessing's lit. That's better.
A blessing. I'll accept the help.
Fire's blessing. Warmth with benefits.
Blessing taken. Thank you, old friend.
That blessing feels like a second chance.
Blessing's burning. Let's make it count.
A blessing. Even I need looking after.
Thank you, fire. I needed the blessing.
Blessing lit. Almost feels like being welcome.
Blessing's ready. Back to earning it.
Bigger fire. Better company.
Look at that fire grow.
A proper flame now. Good.
Fire's grown. I helped with that.
Bigger flame. Bigger excuse to sit.
There you go, fire. Room to breathe.
Fire's bigger. The welcome feels warmer.
Flame's grown. Try not to look proud.
A bigger fire. Beats a bigger debt.
That flame remembers how to grow.
Bigger fire. Someone's doing well.
Fire's growing. Worth what I spent.
The tree's grown. Well done, old thing.
Look at that tree. Still trying.
Bigger tree. Better place to come back.
Worldroot's growing. I won't pretend I don't care.
The tree grew. Show-off.
More tree. Less reason to leave.
Tree's grown again. I remember it smaller.
Look at Worldroot grow. Stubborn as me.
A bigger tree. Something's going right.
Worldroot's grown. I owe it a visit.
Tree's growing. Better management than my last job.
The tree grew. I'll take some credit.
I like people. In manageable quantities.
My best plans involve a chair.
I tried retirement. Couldn't afford the hobby.
I had another name. Never liked it.
I should write home. Which one, though?
Clean socks. That's the real dream.
I've been called worse. Usually by friends.
Still haven't learned to say no.
It wasn't a cult. We had snacks.
I had a digging joke. Buried it.
Remind me to develop a cheaper personality.
Some nights, I remember a different moon.
I miss someone. That narrows it down.
Nobody back home would believe this job.
I used to be taller. Long story.
I should charge extra for optimism.
I miss the sea. Strange, that.
My reputation's worse than my cooking. Barely.
Don't tell anyone I enjoyed myself.
I'd make a terrible saint. Good listener, though.
I remember home. Just not its name.
